scenarios.title: A｜正常退货
scenarios.setting: 玩家拿着前几天购买的商品回到店里。

turns.text: Hi. How can I help you?

turns.prompt: 你想了解退换或退款的处理办法，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I’d like to return this, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to return this, please.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I’d like to return an item I bought here a few days ago.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to return an item I bought here a few days ago.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Is it possible to return this?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is it possible to return this?
feedback.explanation: 先问是否有可能安排，适合需要对方查看余位或规则的请求，语气比直接要求更柔和。

choices.text: I bought this here, but I’d like to return it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I bought this here, but I’d like to return it.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I want to give this back.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to return this, please.
feedback.explanation: 购物退货通常用“return this”；“give this back”能懂，但不如专门的退货动词准确。

turns.text: Sure. Is there anything wrong with it?

turns.prompt: 关于「退货」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: No, there’s nothing wrong with it. I just changed my mind.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, there’s nothing wrong with it. I just changed my mind.
feedback.explanation: 用“there be”说明存在的事物或情况，先呈现事实，便于对方继续处理。

choices.text: It works fine. I just don’t need it anymore.

feedback.naturalExpression: It works fine. I just don’t need it anymore.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

choices.text: I realized it’s not quite what I need.

feedback.naturalExpression: I realized it’s not quite what I need.
feedback.explanation: “I realized”表示刚意识到某件事，可用于解释为什么现在才提出或更正信息。

choices.text: Yes, it doesn’t work properly.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: No, there’s nothing wrong with it. I just changed my mind.
feedback.explanation: 这句表示商品有故障，适用于故障退货；如果只是改变主意，就不能用它代替真实原因。

turns.prompt: 对方需要查看资料或物品，你会怎样配合？

choices.text: Yes. Here it is.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. Here it is.
feedback.explanation: “here it is”递交或展示物品时使用，让对方知道所需东西已经准备好。

choices.text: Sure. I have it right here.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. I have it right here.
feedback.explanation: 交代与当前有关的经历或已完成的事，让对方了解这次沟通的背景。

choices.text: I have the digital receipt on my phone.

feedback.naturalExpression: I have the digital receipt on my phone.
feedback.explanation: “receipt”指收据或付款小票，是交易凭证。

turns.text: Great. And the item hasn’t been used?

turns.prompt: 你想说明退货商品的使用状态，会怎么说？

choices.text: No, it’s still unused.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, it’s still unused.
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: That’s right. I haven’t used it.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s right. I haven’t used it.
feedback.explanation: “that’s right”确认对方复述的信息无误，让对方可以继续办理或安排。

choices.text: I opened the box, but I haven’t actually used it.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: No, it’s still unused.
feedback.explanation: “opened”与“used”分开说明，能准确交代开盒未使用的状态；是否可退需要商家核实。

turns.text: That’s fine. I can process the return for you.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great, thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Perfect. Will the refund go back to my card?

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Will the refund go back to my card?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

scenarios.title: B｜没有小票
scenarios.setting: 在“退货”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“没有小票”。

turns.text: Hi, I’d like to return this, please.

turns.prompt: 你想说明自己已经没有购物小票，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m afraid I don’t have the receipt anymore.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m afraid I don’t have the receipt anymore.
feedback.explanation: “receipt”指收据或付款小票，是交易凭证。

choices.text: I think I lost the receipt. Is there another way to return it?

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I lost the receipt. Is there another way to return it?
feedback.explanation: “receipt”指收据或付款小票，是交易凭证。

choices.text: I don’t have the paper receipt, but I paid by card.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t have the paper receipt, but I paid by card.
feedback.explanation: “I paid”交代已使用的付款方式，方便查账或办理退款。

choices.text: Could you look up the purchase using my card?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you look up the purchase using my card?
feedback.explanation: “look up”表示查找记录或信息，适合请求店员查询购买记录。

choices.text: I threw the receipt away. Can you still take it?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’m afraid I don’t have the receipt anymore.
feedback.explanation: 这句能说明没保留小票；“Can I still return it?”比“take it”更明确问退货资格。

turns.text: Do you have any proof of purchase?

turns.prompt: 你想在没有纸质小票时提供其他购买凭证，会怎么说？

choices.text: I have the transaction on my banking app. Would that work?

feedback.naturalExpression: I have the transaction on my banking app. Would that work?
feedback.explanation: “transaction”指一笔交易，日期和金额有助于定位对应记录。

choices.text: I may have an email receipt. Let me check.

feedback.naturalExpression: I may have an email receipt. Let me check.
feedback.explanation: “receipt”指收据或付款小票，是交易凭证。

choices.text: I paid with this card. Can you look up the transaction?

feedback.naturalExpression: I paid with this card. Can you look up the transaction?
feedback.explanation: “look up”表示查找记录或信息，适合请求店员查询购买记录。

choices.text: What else can I use as proof of purchase?

feedback.naturalExpression: What else can I use as proof of purchase?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

turns.text: If you paid by card, we may be able to find the transaction. Do you remember when you bought it?

turns.prompt: 关于「退货」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: It was last Saturday afternoon.

feedback.naturalExpression: It was last Saturday afternoon.
feedback.explanation: 报出上周六下午这一购买时段，有助于店员检索交易。

choices.text: I think it was about five days ago.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think it was about five days ago.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: I’m not sure of the exact time, but it was last weekend.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure of the exact time, but it was last weekend.
feedback.explanation: 明确表达不确定，让对方知道需要进一步确认，而不是把猜测当作事实。

turns.text: Okay, let me see if I can find it.

scenarios.title: C｜超过退货期限
scenarios.setting: 在“退货”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“超过退货期限”。

turns.text: Hi, I’d like to return this jacket, please.

turns.prompt: 关于「退货」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: About five weeks ago.

feedback.naturalExpression: About five weeks ago.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: I bought it just over a month ago.

feedback.naturalExpression: I bought it just over a month ago.
feedback.explanation: “just over a month ago”表示一个多月前，能说明购买时间大约超过一个月。

choices.text: I don’t remember the exact date, but I have the receipt here.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t remember the exact date, but I have the receipt here.
feedback.explanation: “I don't remember”表达自己没有印象，并不直接断言这件事从未发生。

turns.text: I’m afraid our return period is thirty days, and this was purchased thirty-seven days ago.

turns.prompt: 你想询问超过退货期限是否仍有处理空间，会怎么说？

choices.text: I see. Is there any flexibility with the return period?

feedback.naturalExpression: I see. Is there any flexibility with the return period?
feedback.explanation: 表示已经听懂或理解原因，给对方一个确认信号。

choices.text: Would it still be possible to return it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it still be possible to return it?
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: Is there anything you can do in this situation?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything you can do in this situation?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Would an exchange be possible instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would an exchange be possible instead?
feedback.explanation: “instead”表示改用另一种方案，能让对方知道原来的选择需要替换。

choices.text: It’s only seven days late. You have to return it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I see. Is there any flexibility with the return period?
feedback.explanation: 要求商家“必须退”容易使协商僵住，“return it”也没说清退款责任；询问退货期限是否有调整空间更便于商量。

turns.text: I’m sorry, but I can’t issue a refund after thirty days.

turns.prompt: 你想了解退换或退款的处理办法，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could I exchange it for something else instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I exchange it for something else instead?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: Would store credit be possible?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would store credit be possible?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: Could I speak to someone who might be able to help?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I speak to someone who might be able to help?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: I understand. Thanks for explaining.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. Thanks for explaining.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。
